findings.text: the conductor-only vacuum saddles are passed as x_points, the filled-cross glyph nova/media/poloidal.py:540 reserves for an ADMITTED saddle, while a conductor-only field admits none and the plotting rule's hollow marker is for other qualified nulls; the caption disambiguates, but both panels now carry the same glyph so the vacuum null reads as an admission.

the label check collects only axes titles, so the LABEL_CHECK line it prints at :830 reports zero clipped and zero overlapping labels for the whole figure while any axis label, tick label or annotation a later panel adds would be excluded from that count without changing the reported number.

the receipt writer stores str(figure_path), an absolute and in a worktree worktree-absolute path, while all three committed receipts carry repository-relative paths (docs/figures/mast-centroid-capability/full-axis-lane/centroid-solve.json:135), so the committed receipt is not what the recorded render command produces and every worktree regeneration needs the same hand relativisation the commit hook forces.

vacuum_axes[0] draws the first in-wall O point and silently drops any others, and draw_nulls has no multi-O vocabulary, so a field with two in-wall minima would record o_points_inside_wall above one while the panel shows a single triangle; all three committed states record zero, so the branch is latent rather than active.
